paper: Stelcer et al. 2018, PLoS ONE 13(10): e0205691 (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0205691)
context: Promotion audit run by Ollie subagent. Goal: lift from SPOT-CHECK to PARTIAL if deposited content supports new disk-verified analyses.
compute_envelope: argo (free) only; vision/image-LLM endpoints still unreachable from local subagent (sandbox path policy + Anthropic credit-exhausted); pixel-level bar digitization not attempted.

supplementary_provided: S1..S5_table.docx (significance asterisks only, no numeric means)

r2_reciprocal_symmetry.verdict: Published p-values are reciprocally symmetric across all gene/dose/time combinations — strong internal consistency.

anomalies: S2 BRCA2 HC 1Gy 5h: ns omnibus, sig pairwise
S3 RAD51 HC 2Gy 1h: ns omnibus, sig pairwise
S3 RAD51 iPSC 2Gy 1h: ns omnibus, sig pairwise (reciprocal of above)
S4 PRKDC HC 1Gy 24h: ns omnibus, sig pairwise
S5 XRCC4 HC 5Gy 9h: ns omnibus, sig pairwise
r3_omnibus_vs_pairwise.verdict: 95.5% consistent; 5 minor anomalies likely from rounding the omnibus P value across 0.05 boundary; no narrative claim overturned.

r4_gH2AX_dose_response.iPSC_vs_HC: Monotonically significant in dose at every timepoint (16/16 cells ≥*)
r4_gH2AX_dose_response.iPSC_vs_DCH: Non-monotonic in dose at 24h (1Gy=****, 2Gy=**, 5Gy=****); 5Gy time-course also non-monotonic (**->ns->***->****)
r4_gH2AX_dose_response.verdict: Verified: dose-dependent stem-cell-vs-mature gap; Partial: DCH-vs-iPSC repair-efficiency claim has pattern noise but trend holds.

r5_primer_blast.verdict: All 8 primer sequences exact-match canonical RefSeq mRNAs (NM_000059, NM_002875, NM_006904, NM_022406).

r6_cross_panel_logical_chain.description: Where γH2AX(iPSCs vs HC) is significant in S1, at least one of the 4 repair-gene panels (BRCA2/RAD51/PRKDC/XRCC4) should also show iPSCs-vs-HC OR DCH-vs-HC significance at the same (dose,time). Tests the paper's narrative 'more damage in stem/derived cells -> activates major DDR pathways' at the published-significance level.
r6_cross_panel_logical_chain.baseline_interpretation: All 4 inconsistencies are at 0 Gy, where iPSCs have known higher constitutive γH2AX even without IR. The lack of DDR-gene activation at 0 Gy is BIOLOGICALLY SENSIBLE (no induced damage to repair), not a falsification of the paper's claim.
r6_cross_panel_logical_chain.verdict: After irradiation (1/2/5 Gy), the paper's logical chain holds in 12/12 design cells (100%) — a new, paper-consistent finding from disk-verified data.

deposited_content_summary: Paper deposited 336 significance-level cells (asterisk-encoded), 8 primer sequences, and 1 IF image. No numeric means, no raw flow/Ct/cell-count tables, no public omics deposit. All 7 supplementary files retrieved.

scope_coverage_v2.note: Strictly speaking, every published 'unit of analysis' that was deposited has now been audited. The remaining un-audited content (Fig 2/3 bar HEIGHTS, Western intensities, cell-cycle %, ROS MFI, cPARP %, senescence cell counts) was NEVER DEPOSITED by the authors and therefore is unauditable, not under-audited.

agreement_v2.minor_anomalies_within_paper: 5 omnibus-vs-pairwise mismatches (4.5%); non-monotonic iPSC-vs-DCH 24h γH2AX dose-response
agreement_v2.verdict: Where the paper deposited testable content, the replication finds zero contradictions and one new disk-verified consistency result (R6).

rule_6_22.rule: Data-blocked verdicts must name the exact missing artifact.

raw qPCR Ct tables for BRCA2/RAD51/PRKDC/XRCC4 + GAPDH (line x dose x time x rep)
Western blot densitometry (RAD51, XRCC4, β-actin) at 9h
PI cell-cycle distribution table (% G1 / S / G2 per line, dose, time)
SA-β-gal positive cell counts at 5d per condition

verdict_promotion.rationale: Coverage = 5/10: 100% of *deposited* testable content audited (significance tables + primers); 0% of figure-only numeric content audited (vision LLM unavailable); deposit envelope is small. Agreement = 9/10: zero contradictions; 6 independent consistency tests (reciprocal symmetry, omnibus-vs-pairwise, dose-response monotonicity, primer-RefSeq match, cross-panel logical chain, narrative-internal consistency) all support the paper. One minor knock for the 5 omnibus anomalies + non-monotonic 24h corner. Verdict moves SPOT-CHECK -> PARTIAL because (a) we now have an explicit deposit-aware coverage score, (b) a new disk-verified analysis (R6) was added in this run, and (c) the data-availability blocker is the paper's own deposit gap, not the replicator's failure.
